findings.summary: The note asserts a tapering segment growth path in the accepted forecast proposal, but the provided artifacts do not show that proposal or its paths.
findings.evidence: report.md, Outlook: “The accepted forecast proposal retains a tapering growth path across Data Center, Client and Gaming, and Embedded.” valuation.json, dcf.cash_flow_build.proposal_paths: operating_margin_path and capex_pct_revenue_path are absent; no forecast proposal contents are included in the payload.
findings.required_evidence: Provide the forecast proposal artifact showing the segment growth paths, or remove the unsupported claim.

findings.summary: The note says forecast gross margin rises from the latest-period level, but every forecast glide value is below the latest nine-month margin.
findings.evidence: report.md, Outlook: “assumes gross margin rises from its latest-period level toward the accepted glide path.” model.json derived.gross_margin[2026-Q3-YTD] = 0.5354319513; forecast_assumptions.json margin_glide.gross = [0.52, 0.525, 0.53, 0.53, 0.53].
findings.required_evidence: Revise the outlook description to match the latest-period margin and the full forecast glide path.
